summary: Independent frozen-source and fixed-runtime review passes the admitted local downstream handler acknowledgement containment. Lead disposition remains separate.

evidence: Inspected all five production deltas and actual receipt fixtures: HTTP/application acknowledgement, version/kind and safe expected-count conservation are checked at fan and the ring-to-stats cascade. Missing, old, malformed or failed replies remain unknown/not attempted, without retries. Outer exception handling cannot return complete.

Ring accepted/cutoff/retained/indexed counts and attributed/eligible/weight-skipped credit counts remain distinct from acknowledged accumulator processing. LearnStats acknowledges processed/skipped only after save; mutation/save rejection invalidates cached state, including ambiguous committed-save cases. Alarm scheduling acknowledgement is separate from saved processing and publication.

Independent fixed runtime passed all 15 learn and 7 holdout cases, including actual ring/stats cascade, failure-after-commit reload, alarm rejection, receipt failures and bounded ring retention. Existing arithmetic and fallback semantics are unchanged.

Actual content afterResponse and outcomeToLearning consume incomplete receipts through fixed numeric nonthrowing diagnostics. Reviewed current caller group verifies held downstream work does not hold the shopper response, consent suppresses fan-out, valid receipts avoid diagnostics, and logger failure does not propagate.

Credit plans are prepared with the existing fresh barrier under ring serialization, then downstream replies are awaited outside that lock; the actual held-cascade case permits /recent while credit acknowledgement is pending. Existing selected W06.05 background barrier case passes.

Final consent setup uses actual initializePublication with synthetic conditional acknowledgement and preserves non-tombstone catalog reads/capabilities. Real readRevision KV failure still logs its fixed fallback and proceeds with defaults; a separately identified one-shot dependency rejection exercises propagated preparation failure. No stricter configuration-read guarantee is claimed.

All nine independently inspected source hashes exactly match STOP, current source, artifact and delta records. Before and after runtime: all 88 artifact pins and 73 protected pins match; nine forward and reverse patches reconstruct exact baseline/final bytes; current contract and artifact digests match.

Exact admitted compound invoked once independently: 24 selected passed, zero failures; 13 other consent cases intentionally unselected and not credited. Full captures below end with exit 0 and are drained.

Reused inspected final worker static compound 80768/7fa458: compiler, scoped lint and whitespace pass on frozen bytes. Lint has zero errors and the same eight baseline warnings, including exact locations/rules/messages; no independent static rerun.

All four failed worker candidates remain in worker.json. Final corrected source/runtime/static evidence supersedes, rather than erases, those failures. This verdict is bounded handler acknowledgement evidence, not full W09/W22 or release acceptance.

inspection.qualification: Reused complete pre-freeze actual-source reviews only after exact nine-hash reconciliation. All pin bytes were independently checked, not inferred from the display.

retained_failures_and_qualifications: runtime-candidate-1 (34148/9629a5): 22 learning passes; both selected consent cases failed at pre-existing catalog publication preconditions before target assertions. Final fixture uses the actual accepted initialization path.
static-candidate-1 (8760/e4f820): compiler passed; lint failed at ten warnings, including two new empty logger callbacks; whitespace was not reached. Only added callbacks were corrected.

runtime-candidate-2 (37953/994fd1): 22 learning passes; selected consent failures exposed an incomplete storage override and an incorrect strict-config-failure expectation. Both were corrected without production policy changes.
static-candidate-2 (82387/30ff52): compiler failed on two missing lifecycle fixture fields; lint/whitespace were not reached. Synthetic catalog pieces now explicitly use live lifecycle.

Final worker runtime 28858/95e0b7 and static 80768/7fa458 supersede those candidates; independent frozen runtime 53218/4ce29b also passes. Expected fixed learning_incomplete diagnostics and existing Vite deprecation warning are retained in raw output.
limitations: Local Node/Vitest with synthetic bindings, not deployed provider performance, customer acceptance or release approval. Thirteen unselected consent cases and broader suites were not run.

Processed denotes existing handler accumulator calls followed by acknowledged save, not unique logical events, model-unit correctness, displayed exposures, durable logical reconciliation or published lift. Alarm scheduling acknowledgement does not prove execution/publication.

Unknown HTTP/body/save acknowledgement may follow effects; no automatic retry of non-idempotent exposures/credits, raw outbox, DLQ/quarantine, new recovery resources or aggregate repair was introduced.
Fresh barrier checks are not an atomic late-erasure fence. Existing retention, duplicate-event, attribution/fold-horizon, full W09/F16/N10 and W22 obligations remain open.
Existing configuration fallback on KV read failure is preserved. Propagated preparation-exception coverage uses a clearly scoped dependency mock, not a new strict read guarantee.
Only the assigned review record was written by this reviewer. Root owns task acceptance and governance handoff.
